answer: Counterparty-diversity stops fakes: each identity locks 70 credits and grows a vine to eight clusters. Each cluster stamps a violet badge, filed in the ocean ledger. Reused counterparties grow a thin vine that fails. First fake 48, k-th 48+7(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 3,544,500 against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 48 once. Auditors replay the vine; two shared counterparties burn both bonds. Rented vines collapse when badges trace to one cluster.
